t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2001, a temporary structure that no longer stands. It was designed by Daniel Libeskind, the Polish-American architect, artist and set designer. Libeskind is known for the Jewish Museum in Berlin, which opened in 2001, and in 2003 he won the competition to produce the master plan for the World Trade Center site in Lower Manhattan. Little else is recorded here, so what you're standing at is mostly a place where one of his designs once briefly stood.
